## TL;DR

Review round 1 found the heal still read only `merge-base..HEAD`, leaving the reporter’s dirty and untracked siblings on disk; it only walked `work/` while landable also forbids `inputs/` and `stories/`; and docs/UI text still promised a partial restore. Round 2 expands heal inputs to committed + staged + unstaged + untracked under those dirs, aligns the heal set with `isForbiddenTaskScopePath` (except `repoos.toml`), heals after failed sync as well as success, tightens staged-commit error handling, and updates AGENTS.md, landable next-step text, and tests.

## Work and rationale

**Heal input set (#1086 review).** `foreignBookkeepingHealCandidates` now unions four git views. `foreignScopeDriftPaths` mirrors landable’s forbidden bookkeeping set across `work/`, `inputs/`, and `stories/`. Drops split tracked (`git rm -f`) vs untracked (`git clean -f`) so pathspec misses do not throw.

**Sync path.** `syncTaskBranch` calls the same restore after an aborted merge, not only after success — matching the kamrai case where sync conflicts but siblings remain in the tree.

**Messaging.** Landable next-step no longer suggests `git checkout main --` for post-merge siblings (handoff drops them). It names handoff and sync as healers. `AGENTS.md` matches main-tip / full-tree restore.

**Tests.** New cases: dirty untracked + unstaged siblings, `inputs/` drift, renamed post-merge drop test title. Handoff integration test updated: staged-only siblings are removed at restore (#1086), not at report time.

**History (acceptance 5).** `git log -15 --oneline -- src/core/landable.ts src/core/git.ts` shows scope evaluation stable; #1076 introduced merge-base-only restore (regression window for post-main landings), not a separate landable regression.

## Approaches tried

- Keeping heal commit-only and relying on the commit gate to unstage: rejected — gate leaves files on disk and landable worktree-clean stays red.
- `git rm` for all drops: fails on pure untracked; split tracked vs clean.

## Challenges and blockers

- `finalizeReviewHandoff` staged-sibling test had to change intent: restore now runs before report commit by design.

## Key learnings

Healing foreign bookkeeping must see the same paths landable sees, in every tree state git can hold, not only committed drift on `work/`.
